text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in Norwegian newspapers this morning.
-Noway's largest life insurer Storebrand and the country's second largest commercial bank, Christiania Bank og Kreditkasse, plan to merge.
-Russian airliner Vnukovo will pay 600,000 crowns to Norwegian authorities to remove parts of the plane which crashed on the Arctic island of Svalbard seven months ago.
-Amnesty International says Norwegian athorities should put emphasis on human rights in meetings with the President of China's Peoples Congress Qiao Shi.
-Tuesday's sharp fall on the Oslo Stock Exchange was the steepest since December, 1992. The Total index fell by 3.1 percent and experts warn against short-term investments in the share market.
-State-owned oil company Den norske stats oljeselskap AS sees an increasing need for natural gas power plants in Nordic countries by 2010.
